changelog: **Closure plan, close-loop survey and the closure report (#1795, story #1788):** ending a pairing (`POST /api/mentorship/[id]/lifecycle`) takes an optional `closurePlan` — the pair's agreed next steps, new `MentorshipRelation.closurePlan`, shown to both sides on the archived pairing and scrubbed on erasure. The close-loop survey is a new `relation_close` survey template (overall 1–5, goals met 1–5, the NPS item, a comment; CONFIDENTIAL) run by the existing survey engine through a day-0 `DAYS_AFTER_END` campaign for BOTH sides — no second survey engine, so invitations, signed links, the two-reminder cap and opt-outs are the engine's. `/admin/analytics/closure` (`GET/POST /api/admin/analytics/closure`, `src/lib/closureReport.ts`, unit-tested) switches it on and reports the pairings ended in a period by lifecycle outcome and end reason, with response rate, median length and aggregate scores above the response floor; only `COMPLETED` counts as a success. Engine fix: a `DAYS_AFTER_END` period (and its invitation round) is now per relation (`after:<n>:<relationId>`), so a mentor who ends two pairings is asked about each; sends under the old key count as sent.

en: When a pairing ends you can write down the agreed next steps, and both sides can read them later.
New report: how pairings ended — by reason, with what both sides said in a short close-loop survey. Only a completed pairing counts as a success.
tr: Bir eşleşme biterken üzerinde anlaşılan sonraki adımları yazabilirsiniz; iki taraf da bunları sonradan okuyabilir.
Yeni rapor: eşleşmeler nasıl bitti — gerekçesine göre ve iki tarafın kısa kapanış anketinde söyledikleriyle. Yalnızca tamamlanan eşleşme başarı sayılır.
de: Beim Beenden einer Paarung könnt ihr die vereinbarten nächsten Schritte festhalten, und beide Seiten können sie später lesen.
Neuer Bericht: wie Paarungen endeten — nach Grund und mit dem, was beide Seiten in einer kurzen Abschlussumfrage gesagt haben. Nur eine abgeschlossene Paarung zählt als Erfolg.
